mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.number, e.name, e.gender, e.age, d.id AS d_id, d.name AS d_name, d.number AS d_number FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON e.dep_id = d.id WHERE e.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee (number, name, gender, age, dep_id) VALUES (#{number}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{age}, #{dep.id})
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET number = #{number}, name = #{name}, gender = #{gender}, age = #{age}, dep_id = #{dep.id} WHERE id = #{id}
